memberdef.name: Convert

briefdescription.para: Get the common semantic for two semantics, with the added imposition that saturated padded types retain the padding bit.
Given a floating point type and a fixed-point semantic, return a floating point type which can accommodate the fixed-point semantic.

detaileddescription.para: This is either Ty, or a floating point type with a larger exponent than Ty.

detaileddescription.para: Src - The source value SrcSema - The fixed-point semantic of the source value DstSema - The resulting fixed-point semantic
